raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (CP, LMFT, LPC, LCSW) in Virginia to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Virginia: Clinical Psychologist, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Professional Counselor, Licensed Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in Virginia = $62,000 - $92,500
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

NOCD is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. NOCD is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws.Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA);Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO);Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA).

raw.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book designed for women navigating the unique season of pregnancy. We are open to different conceptual directions for this resource, including, but not limited to:

  • A general book for navigating the beautifully joyful, deeply transitional, and physically exhausting season of pregnancy through the lens of the gospel.
  • A targeted book that addresses specific emotional or spiritual challenges that often arise during pregnancy, such as anxiety and fear, body image in pregnancy, navigating pregnancy after a previous loss, or preparing for labor and delivery.

The ideal project will combine in-depth theology with deep empathy, meeting expectant mothers right where they are with the comforting truths of God’s Word.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

raw.excerpt: Own every product run from production order to live for sale.
raw.description:
Own every product run from production order to live for sale.

$3,500–4,000/month | Full-time | Remote, US MT overlap
HealthyGut is a supplements brand selling direct through its own Shopify store, Amazon (FBA) and distributor channels. Our product lines include Tributyrin-X, BeSerene IR & Daily, Magnesium-HP, HoloZyme, HCL Guard, HoloImmune and HistaHarmony.

We work with contract manufacturers across Europe and the US, move freight through a mix of domestic and international carriers, and run fulfilment through Shipfusion, our 3PL. Operations are coordinated in Asana, with comms running across email and Slack.

We're a small, focused team building a growing supplements business, and this role is the operational backbone that keeps every product moving from formulation through to live sale.

We're looking for an Operations Manager who owns the end-to-end journey of every HealthyGut product — from the moment a production order is placed with a contract manufacturer, through freight, import and quality documentation, to finished goods checked into 3PL inventory and live for sale across every channel.

This is a coordination-heavy operations role sitting at the intersection of manufacturing, logistics, regulatory/quality documentation and e-commerce catalog management. You'll keep many concurrent product runs moving on schedule, maintain the master records everyone else relies on, and act as the central communication hub between outside partners (manufacturers, freight forwarders, the 3PL) and internal leadership, marketing and inventory planning.

Some overlap with US Mountain Time is needed, but exact working hours are negotiable.

What you'll actually be doing

Production & manufacturing coordination

  • Track purchase orders and production timelines with contract manufacturers for every SKU and run
  • Check in ahead of each reorder to confirm lead times, secure production slots and flag risks to stock coverage
  • Coordinate formula updates and reformulations — ingredient changes, capsule-size constraints, potency targets — including routing R&D contracts and bench testing
  • Source raw ingredients — identify and qualify suppliers, request samples and specifications, gather quotes, and compare options on both quality and cost so the Founder/Formulator can make the call
  • Track raw-ingredient sourcing and documentation, and decisions on existing vs. new material lots
  • Track production invoicing: down payments, proformas, credit notes and final invoices

Freight, import & insurance

  • Solicit and compare freight quotes across carriers for domestic and international lanes, and book pickups
  • Coordinate international air freight and import logistics — customs clearance, customs bonds, TSCA documentation and FDA release
  • Arrange cargo insurance per shipment and confirm full shipment value is covered
  • Act as the logistics point of contact between manufacturers, forwarders and the 3PL

3PL intake & inventory (Shipfusion)

  • Create inbound shipments for every run and component order (bottles, pill cases, glass jars)
  • Create and configure new SKUs — cost, retail price, weight, country of origin, HS/tariff codes
  • Enter and update case sizes, unit counts, weights, dimensions and lot/expiration dates
  • Track check-in and resolve discrepancies — damaged, missing or rejected units

Quality documentation (CoAs)

  • Request current CoAs from manufacturers for each new lot and locate historical ones when needed
  • Edit raw CoAs into public-ready versions, upload both to the shared drive
  • Maintain the master CoA spreadsheet and hand public-ready files to Marketing

Labels, renders & creative assets

  • Coordinate new and updated label designs with manufacturers and the label printer — proofs, dies, estimates
  • Prepare and route label files, convert to web-ready formats, hand off to Marketing
  • Request updated 3D bottle renders for new sizes, formula changes and label corrections
  • Maintain the master label spreadsheet and share assets with distributors

E-commerce catalog & channel updates

  • Update Shopify and Amazon with new ingredient info, labels and imagery when formulas change — timed to sell-through of old stock
  • Add and update product weights and dimensions in Shopify and the 3PL
  • Manage stock states: sold-out flags, backorders, product and instruction pages

Amazon FBA restocking

  • Plan and send FBA replenishment shipments, coordinating quantities with the inventory/Amazon lead
  • Time restocks around Prime Day, Black Friday/Cyber Monday, and allocate stock between the 3PL and Amazon

Cross-functional coordination & record-keeping

  • Serve as the central tracking hub from order to shelf, keeping leadership, marketing, inventory planning and distributors informed
  • Maintain master tracking spreadsheets (labels, CoAs, HG + Amazon case & lot info) as the single source of truth
  • Consolidate comms from email, Slack and Asana into one organised, auditable task system

Where the role can grow

There's real scope to take on more ownership. Over time we'd like this person to move us from reactive to proactive:

Demand planning & reorder points — reorders triggered by data-driven exhaustion dates and safety-stock targets rather than last-minute days-of-stock math

Landed-cost & COGS tracking — a per-run model covering unit cost, freight, duties/tariffs and insurance to inform pricing and margin

Vendor & 3PL performance management — a supplier scorecard (on-time delivery, quality, damage rates), structured check-ins and a formal damage-claim process

Regulatory & compliance stewardship — an organised library of TSCA, FDA, GMP/NSF and import documentation, with registrations, renewals and audit-readiness tracked

SOP documentation — writing these workflows down so the role is transferable and not dependent on one person's memory

New-product & new-size launch management — a standard checklist spanning formula, label, render, CoA, SKU setup, freight and channel go-live

EU/UK expansion support, packaging & component sourcing, and a central PO/payment tracker tied to production milestones

Requirements

To be successful in this role, you need:

✅ 3-5 years experience as an Operations Manager in the supplements, nutraceuticals, or similar industry

✅ Exceptionally organised and detail-oriented — juggles many concurrent product runs and their moving parts without dropping steps

✅ Fluent, or quick to learn, in logistics and import terminology — freight quoting, customs/HTS/TARIC codes, cargo insurance, 3PL operations

✅ Strong spreadsheet and systems skills — Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, a 3PL platform (Shipfusion or comparable), Asana; Google Sheets as a daily tool

✅ Clear, proactive written communicator who keeps partners and internal teams aligned across email, Slack and Asana

✅ Calm under shifting timelines — re-plans quickly when a run slips, a shipment is delayed or stock runs tight

Brownie points for:

⭐ Supplements, CPG, consumer health, integrative wellness or other regulated consumer goods background

⭐ Demand planning and reorder-point / safety-stock forecasting

⭐ Landed-cost and COGS modelling (unit cost + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance per run)

⭐ Regulatory documentation experience — TSCA, FDA, GMP/NSF, import records, registrations and renewals

⭐ EU/UK import-export exposure (EU TARIC codes and a UK entity already appear in the work)

⭐ SOP writing and process documentation

⭐ Vendor / 3PL performance management and damage-claim handling

⭐ Packaging and component sourcing (bottles, lids, cases, jars)

Organisation comes instinctively to you, and being the person everyone else relies on for the current status of things feels natural. You chase the CoA, the freight quote, the check-in discrepancy before being asked. Clear written communication is how you work, and when a run slips or stock runs tight you re-plan calmly rather than escalating. The role demands someone who thrives on keeping many moving parts coordinated and who takes ownership of follow-through across partners and internal teams.

Benefits

What’s in it for you?

💰 $3,500 - 4,000 USD per month*

💼 Full-time

🌍 Fully remote

⏰ Negotiable hours with overlap in US Mountain Time

📅 20 days PTO

🎁 Supplement Family and Friends discount

🎉 Holidays

*Please note that this is a gross salary and that you are responsible for any tax-related procedures in your country of residence. We kindly ask you to apply only if you are happy to work remotely as an independent contractor.

This is our typical hiring process - occasionally, it may include extra steps.

For this role, JobRack is partnering with the company to find their next hire. We’ll handle all the screening and testing, so they see only the best-fit candidates - like you!

🔍 How to shine

• Read the role details carefully.

• Submit a thoughtful, high-quality application.
• Stay responsive - we’ll keep you updated at every stage.

✨ Important notes
• Apply only through JobRack; please don’t contact the company directly.
• We expect a respectful hiring experience - any disrespect means instant disqualification.
• This is a full-time, primary role (no freelancing or second jobs).

raw.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive’s Financial Products team operates a fast-growing commercial lending and spend management program (Motive Card) built on partnerships with issuing banks and card networks. The program already spans the US & Canada with further international expansion planned. We’re hiring a Lead Compliance Manager to build and own the compliance function for this business end-to-end — from policy development through hands-on execution — as it scales into new products, segments, and markets.

Reporting to the Head of Risk, Financial Products, you will be the senior-most dedicated owner of AML/BSA, sanctions, KYC/KYB, and lending-compliance programs that today are stitched together across Product, Legal, Risk Ops, and Engineering. You will manage the compliance relationship with our issuing bank and network partners across every market we operate in, translate regulatory requirements into policy and control design, and ensure those controls actually operate — not just exist on paper — across a multi-geography, multi-partner program. As Motive enters new markets, you will define what compliance needs to look like there before launch, not after.

What You'll Do:

  • Own and maintain Motive’s AML/BSA, Sanctions, and KYC/KYB policies and procedures across all markets where Motive operates — today the US & Canada, with more markets on the roadmap — keeping them current with local regulatory requirements and issuing bank/network requirements
  • Design, implement, and monitor controls for sanctions and PEP screening, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity escalation, including named Compliance Officer/Designee responsibilities where required by regulation or bank partners
  • Serve as the primary compliance point of contact and relationship owner for issuing bank and card network partners in each market, including compliance reviews, exams, audits, and remediation commitments
  • Partner with Risk, Legal, Underwriting, Product, and Engineering to embed lending-compliance requirements into new products and markets before launch
  • Lead internal and third-party compliance audits and exams, driving findings to closure and maintaining audit-ready documentation and evidence across all jurisdictions
  • Monitor regulatory developments across commercial lending, AML/sanctions, and payments in each market Motive operates or plans to enter, and translate them into actionable policy and control updates
  • Build and run the governance structure for the compliance program — reporting, escalation paths, risk committees — giving leadership clear visibility into program health, and establish the playbook for evaluating compliance requirements ahead of entry into any new market
  • Build out the compliance function as it scales, including hiring and managing future team members as scope grows

What We're Looking For:

  • 8+ years of experience in compliance, audit, or risk management within lending, payments, or financial services, including direct ownership of AML/BSA, KYC/KYB, sanctions, and PEP programs
  • Hands-on experience managing compliance relationships with issuing banks, card networks, or other regulated financial partners, including audits and remediation
  • Multi-jurisdiction compliance program experience, including Canada and UK/EU required; additional international experience (e.g., Mexico or other Latin American markets) a strong plus
  • Working knowledge of the regulatory frameworks governing commercial lending, AML/sanctions, and payments across North America and Europe (e.g., BSA, FinCEN, FINTRAC/PCMLTFA, OFAC sanctions, UK/EU AML and data protection regimes)
  • Proven ability to both write policy and operationalize it — building controls, procedures, and monitoring that hold up under audit, not just documentation
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Product, and Engineering to launch compliant products in new markets
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Motive credibly to external regulators, auditors, and bank partners, and to advise senior leadership on compliance risk
Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visitingMotive Perks & Benefits.

The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. Motive uses three geographic zones to determine pay range. For this role, the compensation ranges are:
San Francisco, California
$163,000—$225,000 USD
U.S. metropolitan areas: Los Angeles, San Diego, New York City Area, Seattle, Washington D.C.
$142,000—$195,000 USD
Other locations in the United States
$142,000—$195,000 USD

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

UK Candidate Privacy Notice here.

(“Employer”) discloses candidates may be required to execute a non-compete covenant with the Employer. This requirement does not apply to lawyers, interns, or employees working in CA, MN, MT, ND, OK, or where otherwise prohibited by law.

Non-compete covenant terms in all other jurisdictions will be subject to the applicable statutory requirements, including but not limited to, procedures, industry related prohibitions, or salary and compensation thresholds.

raw.description:
Akinox s’engage à être un véritable agent de changement. Nous cherchons à faire une réelle différence dans la vie des gens à l’aide de solutions numériques modernes permettant des soins accessibles, efficaces, collaboratifs et centrés sur le patient. Nous connaissons la puissance de l'innovation et nous sommes déterminés à l’utiliser pour moderniser les systèmes de soins de santé!

🏖️Travail à distance: Comme tu seras en télétravail en permanence, tu pourras travailler d’où tu veux, (y compris au bord d'une plage !), il suffit que ce soit sécuritaire et qu'il y ait une bonne connexion internet.

✅Flexibilité : Tu as une famille, tu aimes t’entrainer à 13h ou tu as simplement une vie remplie, on te comprend. Nos horaires flexibles de 35 heures te permettent de gérer ton horaire de manière à répondre à tes besoins personnels tout en étant pleinement engagé.e dans ton travail.

🪙Salaire compétitif : Notre rémunération globale a été conçue afin d’être compétitive. Aussi, tu débutes avec minimum 5 semaines de vacances, peu importe le nombre d’années d’expérience.

🧘‍♀️Avantages sociaux : Parce que nous voulons ce qu’il y a de mieux pour le bien-être de notre équipe, nous offrons une vaste gamme d'avantages sociaux généreux, y compris un PAE, un REER et une assurance collective comprenant une assurance-vie, médicaments, vision, dentaire, voyage et bien plus !

📖Apprentissage continu : Nous nous engageons à te permettre d’acquérir une expertise et de la perfectionner en t’offrant un budget annuel pour continuer à te développer.

🤝Collaborateurs.rices :  Travailler en groupe, c'est travailler avec le souci de l'harmonie et de l'efficacité des actions. Tu travailleras en étroite collaboration avec une équipe extraordinaire et talentueuse, et qui a à cœur d’apporter un impact concret sur le quotidien des professionnels.les de la santé et surtout améliorer l’expérience des !

En tant que DevOps Senior au sein de l’équipe Infrastructure, tu auras pour mission de guider, soutenir et faire évoluer l’équipe responsable du bon fonctionnement, de la sécurité et de la performance de nos environnements infonuagiques.

Tu contribueras à faire grandir notre culture DevOps en favorisant la collaboration, l’automatisation et la fiabilité à grande échelle. Ton leadership permettra à l’équipe d’atteindre l’excellence opérationnelle, tout en accompagnant la croissance de notre plateforme Linx et Carepath et de nos nouveaux produits SaaS.

Tu travailleras en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement, de sécurité, de conformité et de support afin de livrer des solutions robustes, sécuritaires et évolutives, dans un environnement dynamique où l’impact social guident nos choix.

Responsabilités principales

  • Travailler au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire d’administration de systèmes et de sécurité.
  • Participer à la conception, planification, organisation et coordination des projets d'infrastructure, y compris les mises à niveau de logiciels, les migrations de données et l'implémentation de nouvelles technologies;
  • Accélérer l’innovation en adaptant l’infrastructure et les pratiques d’infrastructure aux besoins des équipes de développement
  • Participer aux rencontres avec les développeurs pour mieux analyser les diverses demandes;
  • Améliorer l’automatisation de la configuration et du déploiement de l'infrastructure, en assurant un pipeline d'intégration et de déploiement continus (CI/CD) fluide et efficace;
  • Procéder aux déploiements de nos solutions
  • Améliorer les outils de surveillance et d’observabilité pour détecter et diagnostiquer les enjeux techniques et de sécurité;
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les autres départements (développement, support, sécurité, conformité, etc.)
  • Continuellement améliorer la performance et la stabilité des environnements
  • Contribuer à la documentation technique, aux revues d’architecture et au partage des connaissances avec l’équipe

Tu t’adapteras bien au rôle si :

  • Tu as une bonne expérience au sein d’une équipe DevOps et tu maîtrises Kubernetes
  • Tu as déjà déployé et supporté des applications SaaS dans un cloud public, idéalement hébergées sur Azure
  • Tu as une excellente capacité à communiquer avec plusieurs équipes et à gérer leurs différentes attente
  • Tu as de l'expérience en développement, notamment avec des langages de programmation moderne comme C#, Python, etc.
  • Tu guideras tes collègues plus junior vers l'atteinte de leurs objectifs et tu seras en mesure de rassembler les différentes idées vers un but commun
  • Tu maîtrises un ou plusieurs outils IaC (Pulumi de préférence) et tu aimes automatiser
  • Tu as déjà utilisé ArgoCD ou un équivalent GitOps pour orchestrer des déploiements
  • Tu connais bien l’univers des microservices et tu as une solide compréhension des concepts de réseau, sécurité et scalabilité
  • Tu maîtrises bien l’architecture infonuagique
  • Tu sais collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (infra, dev, sécurité, support)
  • Tu aimes documenter, partager tes connaissances, et tu te reconnais dans un style de leadership collaboratif
  • Tu te débrouilles bien en anglais ou tu es bilingue (FR/EN) puisque tu auras à intervenir auprès d'une clientèle francophone et anglophone.

Tu t’adapteras bien dans notre environnement si:

  • Tu as de bonnes qualités de communication, tu apprécies intervenir dans un rôle de mentor, et tu accordes une grande importance à la documentation.
  • Tu as une bonne capacité à travailler dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide
  • Tu accordes une grande importance à la qualité du produit, à la sécurité, à l’impact social de ton travail et à l’amélioration des soins de santé de la population
  • Tu adhères aux valeurs d’Akinox! (Orienté solutions, bienveillance, esprit de service, humilité et travailler dans le plaisir).

Akinox is committed to being a true agent of change. We strive to make a meaningful difference in people’s lives through modern digital solutions that enable accessible, efficient, collaborative, and patient-centered care. We know the power of innovation, and we are determined to use it to modernize healthcare systems!

🏖️ Remote Work: Since you’ll be working remotely full-time, you can work from wherever you want (even from the beach!), as long as it’s safe and you have a reliable internet connection.

✅ Flexibility: You have a family, like to work out at 1 p.m., or simply have a busy life—we get it. Our flexible 35-hour workweek allows you to manage your schedule in a way that meets your personal needs while remaining fully engaged in your work.

🪙 Competitive Compensation: Our total compensation package is designed to be competitive. You’ll also start with a minimum of five weeks of vacation, regardless of your years of experience.

🧘‍♀️ Benefits: Because we want the best for our team’s well-being, we offer a wide range of generous benefits, including an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), an RRSP, and group insurance covering life insurance, prescription drugs, vision, dental, travel, and much more!

📖 Continuous Learning: We are committed to helping you build and deepen your expertise by providing an annual professional development budget.

🤝 Collaboration: Working as a team means working together with a focus on harmony and effectiveness. You’ll collaborate closely with an amazing and talented team that is passionate about making a tangible difference in the daily lives of healthcare professionals and, above all, improving the patient experience!

The Role

As a Senior DevOps within the Infrastructure team, your mission will be to guide, support, and help evolve the team responsible for the reliability, security, and performance of our cloud environments.

You will contribute to strengthening our DevOps culture by fostering collaboration, automation, and reliability at scale. Your leadership will help the team achieve operational excellence while supporting the growth of our Linx and CarePath platforms and our new SaaS products.

You will work closely with our development, security, compliance, and support teams to deliver robust, secure, and scalable solutions in a dynamic environment where social impact guides our decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work as part of a multidisciplinary systems administration and security team.
  • Participate in the design, planning, organization, and coordination of infrastructure projects, including software upgrades, data migrations, and the implementation of new technologies.
  • Accelerate innovation by adapting infrastructure and infrastructure practices to meet the needs of development teams.
  • Participate in meetings with developers to better understand and assess various requests.
  • Improve infrastructure configuration and deployment automation, ensuring a smooth and efficient continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipeline.
  • Deploy our solutions across our environments.
  • Improve monitoring and observability tools to detect and diagnose technical and security issues.
  • Work closely with other departments, including development, support, security, and compliance.
  • Continuously improve the performance and stability of our environments.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, architecture reviews, and knowledge sharing within the team.

You’ll Be a Great Fit for This Role If:

  • You have solid experience working within a DevOps team and are highly proficient with Kubernetes.
  • You have experience deploying and supporting SaaS applications in a public cloud environment, ideally Azure.
  • You have excellent communication skills and are comfortable collaborating with multiple teams while managing different expectations.
  • You have development experience, particularly with modern programming languages such as C#, Python, or similar technologies.
  • You are comfortable guiding more junior colleagues toward achieving their goals and bringing different ideas together around a common objective.
  • You are proficient with one or more Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools—preferably Pulumi—and enjoy automation.
  • You have experience using Argo CD or a similar GitOps tool to orchestrate deployments.
  • You are familiar with microservices architectures and have a strong understanding of networking, security, and scalability concepts.
  • You have a strong understanding of cloud architecture.
  • You know how to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, including infrastructure, development, security, and support.
  • You enjoy documenting and sharing your knowledge and identify with a collaborative leadership style.

Releaf Dispensary Ltd is a pioneering medical cannabis clinic committed to providing high-quality, safe, and effective cannabis-based products. Headquartered in the UK, we aim to enhance the quality of life for our patients through cutting-edge solutions and outstanding patient service. We are a fast-growing team of passionate professionals on a mission to put patients back in control of their health journey — we have seen first-hand how alternative treatments can change lives.

We are proud to be a certified B Corp — the first medicinal cannabis clinic in the world to achieve this recognition — reflecting our commitment to the highest standards of social and environmental responsibility.

The role

You will report into the Head of Performance Marketing and work closely with our Paid Social Specialist. You’ll own and scale our paid search programme across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising, and to make sure the numbers behind it stand up to scrutiny.

This is an operational role, not an oversight role. You will be in the accounts daily — building, bidding, testing, writing, cutting the data and reporting on what it all means. You'll be managing significant budgets from day one, in a category where advertising is tightly regulated and accuracy matters as much as performance.

The role suits someone who has run large paid search accounts either agency-side or in-house, and who is comfortable in GA4.

Main Responsibilities

Paid search

  • Own day-to-day management of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising accounts — structure, keywords, bids, budgets, negatives, audiences and ad copy.
  • Manage and pace significant monthly media spend against CPA and volume targets, with clear forecasting and in-month course correction.
  • Build and optimise across campaign types, including Search and Performance Max
  • Run a continuous testing roadmap: ad copy, landing pages, bidding strategies, match types, audience layers and creative.
  • Manage search query mining, competitor monitoring and market/keyword expansion.
  • Work within advertising policy and regulatory restrictions specific to our sector — ensuring every ad, extension and landing page is compliant before it goes live, and managing appeals or disapprovals when they happen.
  • Work closely with Google and Microsoft account teams, and get the most out of betas, support and alpha access.

Analytics and measurement

  • Use GA4 to analyse performance end to end — acquisition through to conversion and revenue — and turn that into decisions, not just dashboards.
  • Build and maintain conversion tracking, events, audiences and custom reports in GA4, working with Google Tag Manager.
  • Own paid search reporting: weekly performance, monthly business reviews, and ad hoc deep dives for leadership.
  • Reconcile platform data with GA4 and internal data, and be able to explain the gaps confidently.
  • Build and maintain reporting in Data Studio so the wider business has a single, trusted view of performance.
  • Feed insight back into landing pages, offers and creative — you'll be expected to have a point of view on what should change and why.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Strong, demonstrable, hands-on paid search experience across both Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.
  • Proven track record managing significant paid search budgets with direct accountability for performance.
  • Strong working knowledge of GA4 — reporting, event and conversion configuration, audience building and analysis.
  • Confident with numbers: comfortable in spreadsheets, able to model scenarios, forecast and spot anomalies quickly.
  • Able to work independently and prioritise — this is a hands-on role with real ownership.

Desirable

  • Agency background, or in-house experience in a tightly regulated industry (healthcare, pharma, financial services, gambling, legal or similar).
  • Working knowledge of German — useful for our German-language activity, but not a requirement.
  • Google Tag Manager, Data Studio, and experience with server-side or consent-mode tracking setups.
  • Experience with paid social, programmatic or wider performance channels.
  • Google Ads and GA4 certifications.

We're open on background. If you can prove you're excellent at paid search and rigorous with data, we want to hear from you. At Releaf, we believe that diverse teams build better businesses. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences — and we're happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process if you need them. If you'd like to discuss this, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We’re looking for an Implementation Lead to perform a pivotal role in driving a customer and value proposition centric approach to implementing and configuring our investigative case management SaaS offerings.

In this role, you will be the main point of contact for our customers during the implementation process and you will oversee project management, product configuration, integration and migration requirements gathering/documentation, user training, and post-launch adoption tasks for some of our largest customers. You will become a product and investigative process expert and leverage that knowledge to plan and execute high quality customer onboardings to ensure successful delivery of value to our customers.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full implementation lifecycle from contract signing through go-live and early adoption for new and existing customers
  • Lead multiple concurrent implementation projects, maintaining clear timelines, milestones, and documentation
  • Gather and translate customer requirements into scalable configuration, integration, and migration solutions

What Success Looks Like

  • 6 months: Contribute to predictable delivery, cleaner handoffs, reduced rework, and improved customer readiness for launch or adoption.

raw.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Preparas la prueba de ofimática de oposiciones autonómicas o estatales, con Office 365 o LibreOffice? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy.

💻 Buscamos preparadores/as de Ofimática para oposiciones

La ofimática es una prueba decisiva, y muchas veces eliminatoria, en las oposiciones de perfil administrativo. Cada administración la examina a su manera: con paquetes distintos, versiones distintas y formatos distintos.

Queremos construir un claustro de preparadores especializados en ofimática para oposiciones, con especial foco en las oposiciones de las comunidades autónomas.

🗺️ Especial foco: oposiciones de las Comunidades Autónomas

Buscamos especialmente preparadores que conozcan la prueba de ofimática de los cuerpos auxiliares y administrativos de las comunidades autónomas, porque es donde más cambia:

  • El paquete ofimático: unas comunidades examinan de Microsoft 365 y otras de LibreOffice (Writer, Calc, Impress, Base).

  • La versión: algunas fijan una versión concreta del programa y otras la última disponible.

  • El formato: test teórico-práctico, supuestos sobre capturas de pantalla o ejercicios delante del ordenador.

Por ejemplo, la Comunidad de Madrid examina de Windows y Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Access, Outlook y herramientas colaborativas como Teams o SharePoint) con un test de ofimática propio; la Xunta de Galicia y la Junta de Andalucía, en cambio, examinan de LibreOffice. Por eso necesitamos preparadores que conozcan a fondo la prueba de cada comunidad.

No necesitas conocerlas todas. Buscamos a quien domine a fondo la prueba de su comunidad, o de varias.

🗂️ Dos tipos de prueba

📝 Ofimática tipo test: preguntas sobre funciones, rutas de menús, opciones y atajos de cada programa, a menudo con supuestos sobre capturas de pantalla.

🖥️ Ofimática práctica: ejercicios reales con tiempo limitado o pruebas específicas de ofimática.

🛠️ Paquetes y herramientas

Microsoft 365

  • Word · Excel · Access · Outlook · PowerPoint

  • Herramientas colaborativas: Teams, SharePoint y OneDrive

LibreOffice

  • Writer · Calc · Impress · Base

Común

  • Windows (10 y 11), explorador de archivos, Internet e informática básica

🏛️ Otras oposiciones en las que también buscamos experiencia

  • Administración General del Estado (Auxiliar y Administrativo)

  • Justicia (Tramitación Procesal y Administrativa)

  • Sanidad (Auxiliar Administrativo y Administrativo)

  • Ferroviarias (áreas administrativas de ADIF y Renfe)

  • Ayuntamientos, diputaciones y universidades (por ejemplo, el Ayuntamiento de Madrid)

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Preparadores/as de ofimática para oposiciones, sobre todo de cuerpos auxiliares y administrativos autonómicos.

  • Funcionarios/as con plaza que hayan superado la prueba de ofimática de su comunidad y quieran enseñarla.

  • Formadores/as de ofimática (Microsoft 365 o LibreOffice) con interés en el mundo de las oposiciones.

  • Personas que sepan cómo pregunta cada tribunal: qué versión, qué funciones y qué tipo de supuestos.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar paso a paso, detectar errores y hacer fácil lo que parece técnico.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online de Microsoft 365 o LibreOffice, adaptadas a la prueba de cada comunidad.

  • Preguntas tipo test y supuestos sobre capturas con el formato de cada tribunal.

  • Ejercicios prácticos con tiempo limitado y su corrección.

  • Resolución en vídeo de exámenes oficiales de convocatorias anteriores.

  • Simulacros de la prueba de ofimática.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos, vídeos cortos, esquemas y guías de atajos.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

  • 5 - 7 years of experience in software development and team management
  • Previous experience of reporting to a Founder or Senior Leadership team or a career history of working in small, high growth scale up organisations over larger corporations
  • Ideally worked for an e-commerce, online marketplace or OTA business
  • Bachelor's degree in software engineering, computer science, information systems, information technology, or similar

Technical

  • In-depth knowledge of Python ( at least 7+ years ) and understanding of JavaScript/Vue.js and the rest of our tech stack
  • Extensive experience in developing, deploying, and integrating software solutions
  • Proficiency in documenting processes and monitoring performance metrics

  • Bias to Action
  • Conscientious

  • Results focused
  • Initiative and responsibility

Our stack comprises:

  • Kubernetes

  • Redis
  • Solr

  • Nginx

More about Pitchup

Pitchup.com receives 33m annual visits and up to 7,500 bookings per day, with total transaction value 50% up compared to 2022 (a record-breaking year). So far £260m worth of holidays have been booked through us and we’ve helped 9m holidaymakers make their great escape. This year we launched our new mobile website, updating the look and feel and increasing conversion, with the desktop version soon to follow. The company is profitable and was founded in 2009 by former lastminute.com staff with a background in the holiday park sector.

Our site has been featured in leading global media titles, such as BBC News, New York Times, Le Figaro, and more, and has been translated into 17 languages. TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.

raw.description:
Your Purpose

At Bitso, the Software Engineer on the Nexus Squad owns the reliability, scalability, and evolution of our mission-critical pay-in and pay-out systems, the financial backbone that moves billions of dollars worldwide.

You will design and deliver event-driven, high-throughput solutions that ensure every pay-in and pay-out is fast, accurate, and resilient.

Working closely with product, infrastructure, and compliance stakeholders, you will shape the technical direction of a domain where the bar for quality is exceptionally high, resilience is built through continuous learning, and every millisecond of performance matters — for the millions of retail users and the businesses that rely on Bitso to power their financial operations.

Reports To

This role reports to the Nexus Engineering Manager.

Who You Are

  • You are experienced in Java backend development, with a proven track record of shipping production systems at scale.
  • You are familiar with event-driven architecture patterns (event sourcing, CQRS, sagas) and have hands-on experience operating Apache Kafka in high-throughput, real-money environments.
  • You have designed and implemented distributed, fault-tolerant microservices that handle financial or similarly critical transactional data.
  • You have solid experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), including schema design, migrations, and query optimization.
  • You are comfortable with cloud-native infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or equivalent), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • You communicate complex technical concepts clearly in English, written and spoken, to engineering peers, product managers, and senior leadership.
  • You work with a high degree of autonomy and ownership — you identify problems, propose solutions, and see them through to production.
  • You are familiar with AI-assisted development flow and tools (Cursor, Claude, CodeRabbit).
  • You have a strong sense of urgency and are comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-stakes fintech environment.
  • Financial Domain (nice to have):Familiarity with payment rails, reconciliation or idempotent transaction processing in financial systems is a strong plus.

What You Will Do

  • Own pay-in and pay-out systems: design, build, and maintain the core infrastructure that processes financial transactions and moves billions of dollars worldwide.
  • Architect event-driven solutions: design Kafka-based pipelines and workflows that guarantee correctness, ordering, and resilience at scale.
  • Drive technical decisions: lead architecture discussions, define and use patterns, and set standards for the pay-in and pay-out domain in collaboration with the Nexus team.
  • Deliver high-quality code: write clean, well-tested, high-performance Java code and champion engineering best practices through code reviews.
  • Embrace AI-assisted development: leverage tools like Cursor, Claude, and CodeRabbit as part of your everyday workflow, contribute to skills and guardrails development, and apply Spec-Driven Development (SDD) practices to ensure solutions are well-defined, reviewable, and aligned before implementation begins.
  • Ensure system reliability: proactively monitor, debug, and resolve production incidents with a focus on root-cause analysis and lasting fixes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: partner with Product, Compliance, and Finance stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into sound technical solutions.
  • Mentor and uplift: share knowledge with fellow engineers, contribute to internal tech talks, and foster a culture of continuous improvement within the squad.
  • Improve observability: instrument services with comprehensive metrics, logs, and traces to enable rapid diagnosis and confident deployments.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.

Position Overview

We are seeking an accomplished Software Architect to lead the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise‑grade, cloud‑native Java applications. In this pivotal role, you will define architectural standards, mentor engineering teams, drive adoption of modern development practices — including AI‑augmented workflows — and ensure our systems are built for resilience, scalability, and long‑term maintainability.

You will serve as the technical authority across multiple product domains, collaborating closely with product management, DevOps, and senior leadership to align technology decisions with strategic business objectives.

Position Details

Job Title: Software Architect
Department: Engineering – Architecture & Platform
Reports To: VP of Engineering
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Experience: 15+ Years Software Engineering; 5+ Years Architecture

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

  • Define and enforce enterprise architecture standards, patterns, and conventions across all product domains
  • Lead technical design sessions and author Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) for major system changes
  • Establish and refine microservices topology, service contracts, and inter‑service communication strategies
  • Oversee database schema design, migration versioning, and data consistency strategies across distributed systems

Engineering Excellence

  • Drive adoption of SOLID principles, Gang‑of‑Four design patterns, and reactive programming paradigms
  • Establish code quality gates: minimum 85%+ test coverage enforced via CI/CD pipelines
  • Introduce JMH micro‑benchmarking for performance‑critical paths and define SLOs for critical services
  • Own OpenAPI/Swagger documentation standards and API versioning governance
  • Guide proper exception hierarchy design, structured logging, and observability best practices (traces, metrics, logs)

AI‑Augmented Development

  • Champion integration of AI‑assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, JetBrains AI, Cursor, Claude) into the SDLC
  • Define guidelines for safe, productive, and auditable use of LLM‑generated code in production systems
  • Evaluate and prototype AI/ML integration patterns: LLM API consumption, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), embedding pipelines, and vector store integrations within the Java/Spring ecosystem
  • Develop internal AI‑powered productivity tooling (code reviewers, test generators, documentation assistants) using Spring AI or LangChain4j
  • Ensure AI‑generated outputs comply with security, licensing, and intellectual property policies

Cloud‑Native & Infrastructure

  • Architect cloud‑native solutions on GCP leveraging Kubernetes, service meshes, and managed data services
  • Define containerisation, configuration management, and secret management standards
  • Lead distributed transaction strategy using Saga patterns, idempotent consumers, and outbox patterns
  • Oversee CI/CD pipeline architecture and promote GitOps workflows

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Mentor senior and mid‑level engineers in architectural thinking, design patterns, and production‑readiness criteria
  • Conduct architecture reviews, technical due diligence, and proof‑of‑concept evaluations
  • Collaborate with Product and Business stakeholders to translate requirements into actionable technical roadmaps
  • Represent the engineering organisation in cross‑functional architecture committees and vendor evaluations

Technical Requirements

Core Java & Spring Ecosystem

  • Java 17+
  • Spring Boot 3.x & Spring Framework 6.x
  • Spring Security (OAuth 2.1, JWT, OIDC)
  • Spring Data JPA / R2DBC / Redis
  • Spring Cloud
  • Reactive Streams
  • Maven & Gradle build tooling
  • Hibernate ORM & Flyway migrations

Enterprise Patterns & Architecture

  • Domain‑Driven Design (Aggregates, Bounded Contexts)
  • CQRS & Event Sourcing (Axon / custom)
  • Saga Pattern (Choreography & Orchestration)
  • Repository & Unit of Work Pattern
  • Specification Pattern for query composition
  • Strategy, Factory, Builder, and Decorator Patterns
  • Dependency Injection mastery (Spring IoC)

Quality, Testing & Observability

  • JUnit 5, Mockito, TestContainers, ArchUnit
  • JMH Benchmarking & performance profiling
  • SonarQube, OWASP Dependency Check
  • OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger documentation
  • Micrometer + Prometheus + Grafana
  • Distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin)
  • Resilience testing

Cloud, Messaging & Data

  • GCP (container & serverless services)
  • Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD
  • Apache Kafka
  • PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
  • gRPC & Protocol Buffers
  • GraphQL
  • REST API design best practices

AI & Machine Learning Integration

  • Spring AI / LangChain4j framework experience
  • LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic)
  • Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
  • Vector databases
  • Embedding models and semantic search
  • AI‑assisted code generation tool governance
  • Prompt engineering & chain‑of‑thought patterns

Qualifications

Required

  • 15+ years of professional software engineering experience with 5+ years in a software architect or principal engineer role
  • Deep expertise in Java 17+, Spring Boot 3.x, and the broader enterprise Java ecosystem
  • Demonstrable production experience with microservices, event‑driven systems, and cloud‑native architectures
  • Strong command of DDD, CQRS, Event Sourcing, and distributed transaction patterns
  • Hands‑on experience with containerised deployments on Kubernetes in a major cloud provider
  • Proven ability to mentor and elevate the technical skills of engineering teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication for both technical and non‑technical audiences

Preferred

  • Experience with Spring AI, LangChain4j, or direct LLM/ML API integration in production Java services
  • Familiarity with AI‑assisted development workflows: Copilot, Cursor, JetBrains AI, or equivalent
  • Contributions to open‑source Java / Spring projects or published technical writing

CSR Calling & Account Support

    account unlocking, and account management.

Work Schedule
This role requires availability for overnight (graveyard) and rotating shifts, with flexibility for weekend work based on business needs.
What Success Looks Like
Success means accurate inventory and listings, completed refunds, and processing work and CSR calls handled correctly and on time. Team Lead priorities are followed, and issues are communicated early.

Expert Construction & Manufacturing

As an expert in the Construction & Manufacturing programme, you understand the essential role these industries play in infrastructure development, industrial growth, employment and sustainable urbanisation.  Are you ready to drive change worldwide and make a real impact? This is your opportunity!

About PUM

PUM is a unique NGO committed to making a positive impact on a global scale. With a network of 1,200 skilled voluntary experts, we collaborate with ambitious entrepreneurs in 26 countries and 12 programmes, sharing expertise to strengthen business ecosystems and create economic, social, and environmental value. We work closely with small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as the organisations that support them. We believe in the power of collaboration and in the magic that happens when diverse perspectives come together; Together we grow!

Who are you?

  • You have a track record of relevant experience in construction and/or manufacturing.

  • For manufacturing, we look particularly for experience with:
    –Chemical Technology.
    – Chemical – Ceramics & Glass (window glass, glass blowing, brick processing).
    – Chemical – Paints (paint formulation, paint application, printing ink).
    – Chemical – Pharma (EU certification pharma products, chemical distillation, pharmaceutical regulatory affairs, cosmetics).
    – Metal (surface treatments, adhesion technology, technological process improvement).

  • You are an authentic, resilient, humble and dynamic professional.

  • You appreciate cultural differences and interact with equality and respect.

  • You are eager to operate as a sparring partner in culturally diverse and changing circumstances.

  • You are hands-on and can translate knowledge into a practical plan.

  • You have excellent command of the English language, both verbally and in writing. Bonus points for French or Spanish proficiency!

  • You are comfortable with digital tools, including Microsoft Office 365.

  • Discover more about the Construction & Manufacturing programme here.

Ready to make a difference?

As an expert at PUM, you play a key role. By sharing your knowledge and experience you’re empowering the sustainable growth of SMEs in countries worldwide. You’re not just an expert - you’re a change maker!

The role

Your application is for a place in our pool of experts for the Construction & Manufacturing programme, not for a specific project. Once you've joined, you will be matched with up to three projects per year, either on location or remotely. Around one in three projects will be delivered as remote advice, though working solely on remote advisory projects is also possible.
On location, you’ll spend two weeks on-site with the client. PUM covers your flight and visa, while the client takes care of your accommodation, meals, and local transportation. You will also receive an expense allowance.
As PUM expert you not only share knowledge, you also:

  • Empower entrepreneurs, supporting their journey toward sustainable and inclusive business development.

  • Leave a lasting impact on the community: socially, environmentally, and economically.

  • Turn your knowledge into a hands-on project plan.

  • Expand your horizons at sector days and building a network that’s as diverse as it gets.

Eligibility and Requirements

The expert role is a voluntary position. You can apply up to and including the calendar year in which you turn 69.PUM engages experts who reside in the Netherlands, are registered in the Municipal Personal Records Database (BRP), and have Dutch basic health insurance. Prescreening (VOG) is part of the selection process. At PUM, we celebrate diversity and inclusion as essential pillars of our organisation. We embrace the uniqueness of each individual to foster an environment where everyone can thrive by being their authentic selves.

Join us!

By becoming a PUM expert, you’re not just stepping into a new role; you’re becoming a catalyst for positive change. It’s a two-way street of knowledge exchange that makes a global impact. Here’s what’s in it for you:

Continuous learning: Embrace new perspectives and gain insights by connecting with diverse people and cultures.
Professional network: Be part of a network of approximately 1,200 volunteer experts and let your network abroad grow as well.
Optimal knowledge utilization: Put your expertise to its best use, making tangible impact on businesses worldwide.
International exposure: Immerse yourself in a multicultural environment, broadening your horizons.
Building a brighter future: Contribute to the sustainable development of communities, cultivating a profound sense of fulfillment.
Stunning office moments: Enjoy regular meetups at our beautiful office in The Hague with breathtaking views.

We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we may close the vacancy once we’ve found enough qualified candidates.

Highlights

You’ve got the skills! Why not share them? Join PUM as an expert to help build a better future for SMEs and their communities worldwide!

OUR MISSION

Generate is a Boston-based MIT-spin off technology company with the mission to digitize one of the world’s largest and least digital industries: the 12-trillion-dollar Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) sector.

We are bringing the many innovations and techniques from state-of-the-art gaming technology (like Proceduralism, GPGPU, Real-Time Graphics, and more) into transforming how the AEC sector designs and builds. When implemented at scale, our technology can help tackle the global climate and housing crises by accelerating the deployment of cost-effective, sustainable building materials and systems.

Our team is seeking an experienced Unreal Engine C++ Software Engineer to develop and deploy the technology at scale.

YOUR ROLE

In this role, you will:

  • Work as part of a small development team in a lean engineering environment on incremental releases of design software with a planned public launch in Q4 2022. You will make significant contributions to the software's structure and features with a laser focus on providing a fluid, game-like, user-centric design experience.
  • Contribute to significant aspects of the product development process — data structures, algorithm design, computational geometry, procedural geometry generation, history systems, inferencing and constraint systems, and building information modeling systems, runtime procedural construction system generation, runtime procedural building facades and interiors, custom compute based rasterization in Unreal Engine, and Houdini-esque building design tools.
  • Contribute expertise and intuition to monthly feature development workshops, bi-weekly sprint planning meetings, and quick daily standups.
  • Engage in open-ended workshop sessions, to help the product get from "a user wants to do X" to "here is how we will implement X, given our product architecture."
  • Collaborate with our small, cross-functional team of game developers, architects, and product designers to develop innovative solutions to creating and generating buildings (walls, floors, windows, doors, beams, columns, furniture, etc.).

REQUIREMENTS

  • Deep, intuitive understanding of Unreal Engine 4 (mandatory).
  • Deep, intuitive understanding of C++ and modern software design principles.
  • Track record in the software, technology, or game industries.
  • Experience building and shipping successful games or products.
  • Comfort with the lean product development process in a startup environment: including regular pivots, difficult choices about resource prioritization, and an emphasis on product-market fit.
  • A drive to understand and solve complex problems with novel, creative, and practical solutions.
  • Self-motivated and a self-starter.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, both virtually and in person.
  • Familiarity with version control (We use Git).
  • Operate in a workplace environment conducive to the respectful debate of ideas and opinions. Our team has incredible talent, and our technology will only become better if everyone gets to respectfully challenge each other's ideas to arrive at the best possible solution.
  • Most importantly, treat team members kindly—kindness is contagious, and nobody should feel disrespected in an intrinsically stressful technology-development environment.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with computational and procedural mesh geometry.
  • Previous development of user-facing tools or desktop software.
  • CAD industry experience (Autodesk, Dassault, OnShape, SolidWorks, etc.).
  • Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry experience.
  • With JavaScript systems (Redux, React, TypeScript, Next.js, etc.).
  • Experience with networked systems, distributed data, CRDT, or collaborative editing.

Please include links to any representative code or portfolio samples you can share (Github, Bitbucket, tools, games, apps, etc.) in the "Experience Summary" section of the application. We would prefer candidates in the US, but are eager to talk to anyone with a track record in the game development space and making great software.

Generate is remote work first, but we are also willing to discuss relocation to Boston, Massachusetts: a global epicenter of technological innovation!

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including those from historically underrepresented communities. We are committed to reflecting the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion, both in the workplace and in the products we deliver to the industry. We are excited to hear from you!
