Job Title: Human Resource Manager

Location: South Africa

Job Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: US Hours 8 AM–4 PM EST

Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)

We are looking for a confident, experienced, and highly organised Human Resources Manager to independently manage the day-to-day HR function across the employee lifecycle.

The successful candidate will be responsible for recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, payroll and timekeeping, compliance, disciplinary processes, and terminations. This role requires someone who is proactive, discreet, dependable, and comfortable handling sensitive employee matters with professionalism and sound judgment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a strong HR professional who can work independently, take ownership of HR processes, and confidently hold employees accountable when required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment process, including posting vacancies, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and supporting hiring decisions.
  • Oversee employee onboarding and ensure all required documentation is completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage employee relations matters professionally, fairly, and confidentially.
  • Handle employee concerns and sensitive workplace matters with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Manage payroll and timekeeping processes and coordinate with relevant payroll systems.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation.
  • Support and manage compliance with employment policies, procedures, and applicable regulations.
  • Handle disciplinary processes, performance concerns, and employee terminations professionally and appropriately.
  • Coordinate background checks and ensure all required pre-employment processes are completed.
  • Prepare, manage, and maintain employment-related documentation and agreements.
  • Ensure confidentiality is maintained when handling sensitive employee and company information.
  • Support employees and managers while maintaining appropriate accountability and professional boundaries.
  • Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and take a proactive approach to resolving issues.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of HR experience covering recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, payroll/timekeeping, compliance, disciplinary actions, and terminations.
  • Experience independently managing multiple HR responsibilities across the employee lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of HR processes, employee documentation, and workplace compliance.
  • Experience using an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and job boards.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Excel, and communication tools.
  • Experience using payroll and timekeeping systems.
  • Experience using scheduling and calendar management tools.
  • Experience with background-check platforms.
  • Experience using DocuSign or similar e-signature software.
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and remain calm and professional when dealing with sensitive or challenging employee matters.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.

OUR MISSION

Generate is a Boston-based MIT-spin off technology company with the mission to digitize one of the world’s largest and least digital industries: the 12-trillion-dollar Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) sector.

We are bringing the many innovations and techniques from state-of-the-art gaming technology (like Proceduralism, GPGPU, Real-Time Graphics, and more) into transforming how the AEC sector designs and builds. When implemented at scale, our technology can help tackle the global climate and housing crises by accelerating the deployment of cost-effective, sustainable building materials and systems.

Our team is seeking an experienced Unreal Engine C++ Software Engineer to develop and deploy the technology at scale.

YOUR ROLE

In this role, you will:

  • Work as part of a small development team in a lean engineering environment on incremental releases of design software with a planned public launch in Q4 2022. You will make significant contributions to the software's structure and features with a laser focus on providing a fluid, game-like, user-centric design experience.
  • Contribute to significant aspects of the product development process — data structures, algorithm design, computational geometry, procedural geometry generation, history systems, inferencing and constraint systems, and building information modeling systems, runtime procedural construction system generation, runtime procedural building facades and interiors, custom compute based rasterization in Unreal Engine, and Houdini-esque building design tools.
  • Contribute expertise and intuition to monthly feature development workshops, bi-weekly sprint planning meetings, and quick daily standups.
  • Engage in open-ended workshop sessions, to help the product get from "a user wants to do X" to "here is how we will implement X, given our product architecture."
  • Collaborate with our small, cross-functional team of game developers, architects, and product designers to develop innovative solutions to creating and generating buildings (walls, floors, windows, doors, beams, columns, furniture, etc.).

REQUIREMENTS

  • Deep, intuitive understanding of Unreal Engine 4 (mandatory).
  • Deep, intuitive understanding of C++ and modern software design principles.
  • Track record in the software, technology, or game industries.
  • Experience building and shipping successful games or products.
  • Comfort with the lean product development process in a startup environment: including regular pivots, difficult choices about resource prioritization, and an emphasis on product-market fit.
  • A drive to understand and solve complex problems with novel, creative, and practical solutions.
  • Self-motivated and a self-starter.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, both virtually and in person.
  • Familiarity with version control (We use Git).
  • Operate in a workplace environment conducive to the respectful debate of ideas and opinions. Our team has incredible talent, and our technology will only become better if everyone gets to respectfully challenge each other's ideas to arrive at the best possible solution.
  • Most importantly, treat team members kindly—kindness is contagious, and nobody should feel disrespected in an intrinsically stressful technology-development environment.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with computational and procedural mesh geometry.
  • Previous development of user-facing tools or desktop software.
  • CAD industry experience (Autodesk, Dassault, OnShape, SolidWorks, etc.).
  • Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry experience.
  • With JavaScript systems (Redux, React, TypeScript, Next.js, etc.).
  • Experience with networked systems, distributed data, CRDT, or collaborative editing.

Please include links to any representative code or portfolio samples you can share (Github, Bitbucket, tools, games, apps, etc.) in the "Experience Summary" section of the application. We would prefer candidates in the US, but are eager to talk to anyone with a track record in the game development space and making great software.

Generate is remote work first, but we are also willing to discuss relocation to Boston, Massachusetts: a global epicenter of technological innovation!

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including those from historically underrepresented communities. We are committed to reflecting the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion, both in the workplace and in the products we deliver to the industry. We are excited to hear from you!

raw.excerpt: Unser Ziel ist klar: STAYERY wird die führende Serviced-Apartment Marke Europas – mit 100+ Standorten in den spannendsten Städten.
raw.description:
Unser Ziel ist klar: STAYERY wird die führende Serviced-Apartment Marke Europas – mit 100+ Standorten in den spannendsten Städten. Das schaffen wir durch ein very, very extraodinary Produkt und ein herausragendes Team.

Auf unserem Weg stehen wir noch am Anfang und suchen Talente, die Lust haben, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, mit uns zu wachsen und Erfolge als Team zu feiern. Bei STAYERY arbeiten wir wie eine Sportmannschaft: mit Leidenschaft, Teamgeist und hohem Leistungsanspruch – aber immer mit einer guten Portion Leichtigkeit und Spaß.

Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte und gestalte die Zukunft von Hospitality mit uns! 🚀

Requirements

Was machst Du so?

  • Du verantwortest Gästeanliegen und Reservierungen für unsere 11 STAYERY Standorte deutschlandweit.

  • Du unterstützt unsere Gäste während der Anreise und dem Aufenthalt per E-Mail, Telefon, WhatsApp und vers. Buchungsplattformen (z.B. Booking.com).

  • Du koordinierst und verwaltest die Gästedaten in unserem Reservierungssystem Apaleo (ähnlich wie OPERA).

  • Du sorgst für einen reibungslosen Arbeitsablauf im Schichtdienst unter der Woche sowie am Wochenende und an Feiertagen zwischen 07:00 Uhr und 22:00 Uhr.

  • Du kommunizierst eng mit anderen Teams und kannst Prozesse aktiv mitgestalten.

Das hast Du drauf!

  • Du hast eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Hotelfachmann/frau oder Hotelkaufmann/frau und erste Erfahrung im Bereich Reservierung oder Front Office.

  • Du hast Spaß an der Kommunikation mit Gästen, sprichst gerne mit ihnen am Telefon und bleibst in jedem Gespräch locker.

  • Du hast Lust für deine persönliche Einarbeitung ca. einen Monat nach Berlin zu kommen. Selbstverständlich wirst du für diesen Zeitraum bei uns in STAYERY untergebracht.

  • Du wohnst und lebst in Deutschland (arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist bei uns nicht möglich) und möchtest bei uns in Vollzeit durchzustarten.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

Und das gibt's on top!

  • Günstig auf reisen 🧳 - Unsere Mitarbeiter*innen profitieren von zahlreichen Rabatten für ihre nächste Reise. Du erhältst eine Travel Industry Card und sparst so bei Freizeitaktivitäten, Hotelübernachtungen, Zugreisen und vielem mehr. Auch in der STAYERY gibt's Sparpreise für Dich und Deine Friends and Family.

  • Hier sparst du 💸 - Über die Belonio App erhältst Du monatlich einen 50-Euro-Gutschein und zum Geburtstag einen weiteren. Du kannst ihn für verschiedenste Marken aus den Bereichen Mode, Lebensmittel, Home & Living und Entertainment einlösen.

  • Feier mit uns 🪩 - Bei uns wird es Dir nicht so schnell langweilig. Wir halten den Team Spirit hoch, durch regelmäßige Team-Events sowie Firmen-Events wie Weihnachts- oder Sommerfeste. Bei unseren Quartals-Events lassen wir Dich außerdem an der Firmenentwicklung und spannenden Neuigkeiten teilhaben.

  • Technisch einwandfrei 🧑‍💻 - Obst gibt es bei uns auch oft – Apple gibt es jedoch immer. Wir arbeiten auf moderner Hardware, deshalb wirst Du für Deine Arbeit ein MacBook und iPhone verwenden.

  • Freiraum für dich 💡 - Viele sprechen von flachen Hierarchien, wir leben sie. Wir arbeiten alle eng zusammen, völlig egal, welche Funktion wir haben. Durch kurze Entscheidungswege können so Prozesse beschleunigt werden – und Du hast viel mehr mitzureden. Das alles ist Teil des Start-up-Vibes, der bei uns mitschwingt.

Der Weg zu uns 🚀

1. Erstes Kennenlernen - In einem Gespräch mit unserer HR Managerin bekommst Du einen Einblick in STAYERY und die Position.

2. Operations Deep Dive - Lerne unseren Head of Operations Pascal kennen und tauche tiefer in den Operations Bereich bei STAYERY ein. Mach dir beim Probearbeiten einen persönlichen Eindruck von der STAYERY und verschaffe dir einen Überblick über deine zukünftigen Aufgaben.

3. Founder Interview - Im Gespräch mit einem unserer Gründer geben wir Dir einen Einblick in unsere Vision.

Deine Bewerbung
STAYERY ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit und Diversität - unabhängig von Alter, Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, Behinderung, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder sozialer Herkunft. Wir erkennen die Stärke, die in der Vielfalt liegt und fördern eine Arbeitsumgebung, die alle Mitarbeitende gleichermaßen einbezieht und schätzt. Deine Bewerbung kannst Du bei uns auch ohne Bild oder Angaben Deiner Nationalität, Alter und Geschlecht einreichen. Wir freuen uns von dir zu hören!

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate new opportunities through outreach, community engagement, and partnerships within the startup and accounting ecosystems.

  • Contribute to ongoing improvement of sales processes and playbooks, sharing insights to help refine our approach.

Compensation

  • The total OTE pay range for this role, including base salary and commission, is 105,000–170,000+ USD per year. *Base pay is commensurate on experience. Commission is not guaranteed.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in B2B sales, ideally selling accounting, CFO, finance, or other adjacent professional services. We will also consider a diverse background of B2B products and services in lieu of financial services experience.
  • Deep understanding of the financial services industry (client facing accounting, tax, and finance services) highly preferred. This means you know how accounting functions operate — you can hold your own in conversations about cash flow, forecasting, or client capacity.
  • Experience working in HubSpot (highly preferred) or other CRM tools to manage a structured sales process.

Our Top Candidates Will Also Have:

  • Strong organization and time management; able to juggle multiple priorities and maintain momentum across deals.
  • Comfort in a startup environment where agility, adaptability, and initiative are key.

You’ll love working at Graphite because:

  • Balance. We encourage you to take time to recharge outside of the office. You’ll have flexible PTO to enjoy life outside of work.

You’ll have access to many professional development opportunities so that you can keep up with the company’s evolving needs. This position will have a real opportunity to influence growth strategy and career trajectory as we scale
  • We’re creating an environment where everyone can thrive. Our customers are global and diverse, so we’re building a team that is, too.

description: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.

raw.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
raw.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
raw.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.


Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.


Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity
  • Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits
  • An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work
  • The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable
  • The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice
  • A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus
  • Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus
  • Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use
  • Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day
  • Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones
  • Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time
  • Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month
  • A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

Job Title: Senior Marketing Manager

Location: South Africa

Job Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: US Hours (9am-5pm EST)

Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Marketing Manager to take full ownership of a growing company’s marketing strategy, brand positioning, digital presence and lead-generation activities.

This is a senior, hands-on marketing leadership role for someone who can develop the strategy and lead its execution from beginning to end. You will be responsible for strengthening the brand, improving search visibility, generating high-quality leads and developing sustainable referral and partnership channels.

This is not a social media coordinator or content-posting position. We are looking for a commercially minded marketing professional who understands how SEO, paid advertising, content, social media, brand strategy, campaigns and website performance work together to generate measurable business results.

You will have the autonomy to outsource specialist work such as graphic design, web development, copywriting or motion graphics when required, while remaining accountable for the overall strategy, quality and results.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and own the company’s overall marketing and brand strategy.
  • Translate business objectives into clear marketing priorities, campaigns and measurable targets.
  • Create and execute an integrated marketing plan across digital, referral and brand-development channels.
  • Manage campaigns from initial concept through execution, measurement and optimisation.
  • Advise senior leadership on market positioning, growth opportunities and marketing priorities.
  • Build and develop the marketing function as the company grows.
  • Identify when additional specialist support, agencies or contractors are required.

Brand Strategy

  • Strengthen and consistently manage the company’s brand across all platforms.
  • Develop clear and compelling messaging for clients, families, referral partners and other key stakeholders.
  • Ensure all marketing materials reflect a professional, credible and consistent brand.
  • Oversee external designers, copywriters and creative specialists where required.
  • Maintain high standards across all marketing output.

SEO, Website & Digital Performance

  • Develop and execute an SEO strategy to improve search visibility, rankings and organic traffic.
  • Conduct keyword, competitor and market research.
  • Improve website content, structure, user experience and conversion performance.
  • Monitor website traffic, user behaviour, lead sources and conversion data.
  • Identify opportunities to improve website performance and lead conversion.
  • Coordinate website improvements with external developers or specialists.
  • Ensure digital activity is focused on meaningful business outcomes and lead generation.

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, manage and optimise Google Ads and other relevant paid advertising campaigns.
  • Develop campaigns focused on generating high-quality, relevant leads.
  • Monitor campaign performance, budgets, conversion rates and cost per lead.
  • Test and optimise messaging, audiences, landing pages and campaign strategies.
  • Analyse results and make data-driven recommendations.
  • Provide clear reporting on performance, challenges, opportunities and recommended adjustments.

Content, Social Media & Campaigns

  • Develop a content and social media strategy aligned with broader commercial objectives.
  • Oversee the creation of website content, social media content, campaigns and marketing materials.
  • Ensure content is relevant, accurate, engaging and appropriate for a professional healthcare environment.
  • Build brand awareness, engagement and trust across relevant platforms.
  • Manage marketing and campaign calendars and ensure consistent execution.
  • Ensure content supports lead generation and business growth rather than simply focusing on engagement metrics.

Referral & Partnership Marketing

  • Develop strategies to strengthen professional referral relationships.
  • Identify opportunities to generate leads through partnerships, professional networks and community relationships.
  • Develop campaigns and marketing materials that support referral growth.
  • Track referral sources and determine which activities generate the strongest results.
  • Develop sustainable relationship-based lead-generation channels.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Significant experience in a senior marketing, marketing management or brand strategy role.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing an end-to-end marketing strategy.
  • Strong practical knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, social media, digital campaigns, websites and lead generation.
  • Proven track record of generating measurable leads and improving digital marketing performance.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketing data and use it to drive decisions.
  • Experience managing external agencies, designers, developers, copywriters or other specialist providers.
  • Strong understanding of the US market and US consumer behaviour.
  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking, organisation and project management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take complete ownership of marketing delivery.
  • A portfolio or clear evidence of successful campaigns and measurable marketing outcomes will be required.

Highly Advantageous

  • Experience within healthcare, home care, behavioural health, ABA or another regulated service environment.
  • Experience marketing services to US-based audiences.
  • Familiarity with healthcare referral networks and relationship-based lead generation.
  • Experience building, restructuring or scaling an in-house marketing function.
  • Experience working with service-based businesses where lead generation and conversion are key performance indicators.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

Fraud Disclaimer: ReWorks Solutions will never request payment during recruitment or require in-person office visits. All official communication will come from a ReWorks Solutions email address. Please verify any suspicious messages with our team directly.

raw.description:
About Sidekick

At Sidekick, we help people recover faster from injuries. Trusted by Olympic champions and everyday athletes, our products have been featured in Men's Health and Running Magazine. With 94% of users finding relief, we aim to be the go-to injury relief brand.

The role

A lot of performance creative work goes into creating demand that wasn't there. That's not the problem here. Our customer already wants what we sell. Their heel hurts every morning when they get out of bed, or their ankle rolls on uneven ground and they've stopped trusting it.

What they don't believe is that this is the thing that finally works. They've already bought the insoles, done the stretches, and gone to physio twice. So you have to teach before you can sell, and you have to earn trust from someone who has been let down already. It's a harder brief than most, and a more interesting one.

You'll write our paid social advertising and own angle development and testing, reporting to our Creative Director. Expect to ship around 15 briefs a week, a mix of net-new concepts and iterations on ads that are already working. Your week is writing, research, and feedback to editors.

You don't need a physiotherapy background, but you do need to pick up a clinical concept quickly enough to explain it clearly and honestly in fifteen seconds of camera time.

What you'll do

  • Find new winning angles. Better creative is what lets us spend more, so we need a steady supply of ads that keep working as budgets grow.
  • Open new audiences. Runners, older adults worried about falling, people on their feet all day. Each group buys for a different reason, and every one we crack opens up new demand.
  • Get more life out of winners. Read the data weekly, iterate what's working, retire what's finished.
  • Write the scripts. Short and long-form video, hooks that stop the scroll, dialogue that sounds like a real person. This is most of your week.
  • Direct the edit. Brief and manage editors and creators so the idea survives production.
  • Extend what wins. Take proven angles into landing pages and email.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years writing paid social ads that were judged on sales (not brand awareness, engagement etc.)
  • Your ads have been responsible for over $100K+/month in ad spend (across all your ads, for a single brand). We'll ask you to walk us through it.
  • Proof you can iterate on a winner. Plenty of people can write one good ad; we want someone who gets eight more out of it.
  • You've opened a new audience before, and you can name the angle that got you in
  • Excellent writing for spoken word, which is a different skill from writing for the page
  • Strong direct response fundamentals: offer, mechanism, objection handling, proof
  • Experience briefing editors or creators
  • Health, fitness or medical device categories are a plus

What we care about

We want people who are ambitious and hold themselves to a high standard. They don't need to be managed closely, and want to be the best at their craft. The volume is real and the feedback is direct. In exchange you'll see more results in a year than most people see in three. If you're looking for something comfortable, this won't be the right fit for you.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Top of the market for this role. We’ll share compensation details on the first call.
  • Fast-growing company whose mission is to solve chronic pain and injuries
  • You’ll see the direct impact of your work on business results
  • You’ll be held to a high bar, which means you’ll get better fast
  • Fun, approachable yet ambitious colleagues
  • Comprehensive health benefits
  • Work from home

Partnerships Associate

Join a collaborative and ambitious team helping to grow referral partnerships in a modern, fast-growing conveyancing business.

We’re looking for a motivated and relationship-driven person to join Juno as a Partnerships Associate. This is an opportunity to play a key role in building and nurturing relationships with estate agents and mortgage brokers, helping to drive new business and support our continued growth.

Juno is a law firm for the digital age. We’re on a mission to transform the experience of buying and selling a home. We make conveyancing simpler, clearer and faster.

We’re growing fast, and we’re looking for someone who enjoys speaking to people, building relationships and working towards clear targets in a supportive and high-performing team. Previous experience in conveyancing, estate agency, or mortgage brokering is highly desirable.

Juno makes conveyancing simpler, clearer and faster

  • Juno is a modern law firm specialising in residential conveyancing and operating throughout England and Wales.

  • We complete thousands of sale, purchase and remortgage transactions each year, and we’re trusted with panel membership by 80+ mortgage lenders.

  • We’re rated as one of the best conveyancing firms in the UK by our clients (5/5 on Trustpilot) and estate agents and brokers frequently tell us how much they enjoy working with us.

  • We’ve built our own software in-house. Clients can do all their conveyancing online, and always know what’s going on. And we’ve optimised the process to complete transactions 50% faster than the average law firm.

About the role

  • You’ll be responsible for building and managing relationships with our referral partners, including estate agents and mortgage brokers.

  • You’ll be making outbound calls to warm contacts who have previously worked with Juno, gathering feedback and introducing them to our referral process.

  • You’ll convert suitable contacts into active referrers, building your own pipeline and helping generate a steady flow of new client sign-ups.

  • You’ll clearly explain how Juno works, including setting expectations around the types of work we can and can’t take on.

  • You’ll assess whether potential partners are a good fit for Juno and for a long-term working relationship.

  • You’ll act as the relationship manager for your partners, maintaining regular contact through check-ins and being responsive to queries or escalations.

  • You’ll monitor referral activity, including lead flow and conversion rates, and work towards weekly and monthly targets.

  • This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys building relationships, is confident on the phone, and thrives in a target-driven environment.

Salary

Basic salary of £28,000, with on-target earnings of £50,000 in your first year. Commission is uncapped and grows as your partnerships build. Our established team earn £55,000 to £90,000.

Join us

We’re looking for people who enjoy building relationships and want to grow their career at a law firm that’s doing things differently.

If that sounds like you, apply through our Recruitee service with a compelling cover letter and recent CV/résumé.

About the jobeCarsTrade is one of Europe's fastest-growing B2B online used-car auction platforms — 18,000+ vehicles listed weekly, 20,000+ active dealers, and 45% year-on-year growth.
As part of our commercial and operations organisation, we're hiring a Team Lead – Customer Compliance to lead our compliance team and ensure that customer verification is performed with the highest standards of quality, attention to detail, speed, and consistency.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not only manage and coach the team — you will actively perform compliance checks yourself, lead by example, and continuously look for ways to improve how compliance works across the company.
You will own the day-to-day quality of the process while thinking about what comes next: how we can make compliance faster, more scalable, more reliable, and increasingly automated.
About the RoleAs Team Lead Customer Compliance, you will be responsible for making sure our customers are properly verified and compliant throughout their journey with eCarsTrade.
You will lead a team responsible for KYC checks, document verification, screening, and customer compliance, while also handling complex cases and communicating directly with customers when required.
Your role goes beyond checking documents. You'll continuously look at the bigger picture — identifying inefficiencies, improving processes, supporting automation, keeping up with regulatory requirements, and thinking about compliance across multiple levels of the business, including company structures, branches, and different European markets.
You will be the role model for the team: someone who understands the details of compliance, sets the standard for quality and speed, and helps the team become better every day.

Responsibilities

Lead by example
  • Perform KYC, document verification, and screening checks yourself.
  • Set the standard for accuracy, attention to detail, speed, and consistency.
  • Handle complex or sensitive compliance cases and support the team with difficult decisions.
  • Act as the team's role model in compliance knowledge, behaviour, ownership, and execution.
  • Stay close to the operational process so you understand where problems occur and where improvements are needed.
Lead and coach the team
  • Manage and coach Customer Compliance team members in their daily operations.
  • Be a reliable point of contact for the team, providing guidance and support when needed.
  • Monitor the quality and speed of individual and team performance.
  • Provide regular feedback and coaching to improve knowledge, accuracy, and efficiency.
  • Help team members prioritise their workload and handle complex customer cases.
  • Maintain a strong team culture built around responsibility, attention to detail, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure the team consistently meets the required standards for compliance checks and customer response times.
Own the compliance process
  • Ensure customer documentation is thoroughly checked against applicable KYC and business requirements.
  • Maintain high-quality verification and screening processes across the customer lifecycle.
  • Manage compliance at different stages, including:
    • Post-registration
    • Pre-invoice
    • Pre-pickup
  • Ensure that customer compliance requirements are correctly applied before customers progress to the relevant stage.
  • Identify gaps, risks, bottlenecks, and recurring issues in the existing process.
  • Continuously improve workflows to make compliance more efficient without compromising quality.
  • Work towards increasing automation and reducing unnecessary manual work.
  • Think proactively about the next step: what can be improved, simplified, automated, or made more reliable.
Regulatory knowledge and compliance development
  • Keep up to date with KYC regulations, requirements, and best practices relevant to the automotive business across Europe.
  • Monitor changes that may affect customer onboarding, verification, screening, and ongoing compliance.
  • Ensure processes evolve as regulatory and business requirements change.
  • Develop an understanding of compliance across multiple levels of a customer organisation, including companies, ownership structures, branches, and related entities.
  • Identify potential compliance risks and escalate them appropriately.
  • Work with relevant internal teams to ensure compliance requirements are understood and implemented correctly.
Customer communication
  • Directly contact customers when additional information, clarification, or documentation is required.
  • Clearly explain compliance requirements and guide customers through the verification process.
  • Handle sensitive or complex customer conversations professionally and efficiently.
  • Balance a strong compliance standard with a smooth customer experience.
Cross-team collaboration
  • Work closely with Sales, Customer Support, Finance, Back Office, and other relevant teams.
  • Communicate clearly when accounts are approved, require additional information, or cannot proceed.
  • Help internal teams understand compliance requirements and avoid recurring issues.
  • Ensure that confirmed and compliant accounts are transferred smoothly to the relevant teams.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in Compliance, KYC, AML, Customer Verification, Back Office, Operations, or Administration.
  • Previous experience in a team lead, senior, supervisory, or coaching role is a strong advantage.
  • Strong understanding of KYC principles and customer verification processes.
  • Genuine interest in compliance and keeping up to date with changing regulatory requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail — you naturally notice things others might miss.
  • Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • A structured and analytical approach to solving problems.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset: you don't just follow a process; you ask how it can be better.
  • Interest in automation, process optimisation, and building scalable operational workflows.
  • Ability to make sound decisions when dealing with incomplete or complex information.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence communicating directly with customers.
  • High sense of responsibility, reliability, and ownership.
  • Ability to work independently while also coaching and supporting a team.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving international environment.
  • Fluent in English. Other European languages are a plus.
  • Experience in the automotive industry or understanding of the European automotive market is a plus.

Benefits

  • Fully remote position, working from home.
  • Flexible schedule from Monday to Friday.
  • Contractor agreement with a competitive hourly rate.
  • A hands-on leadership role with significant ownership and influence over the compliance function.
  • The opportunity to improve and build processes as the company continues to scale.
  • The opportunity to contribute to the automation and digitalisation of compliance operations.
  • An international, fast-growing company where initiative, creativity, and ambition are valued.
  • A collaborative environment with direct impact on how the business operates.
  • Annual team-building event.
If you are someone who leads by doing, sees the details others miss, constantly looks for the next improvement, and wants to build a compliance function that is faster, smarter, and more scalable, we'd like to hear from you.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: Coupa Integration Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$170,000 Annually
Experience Required: 8+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Coupa Integration Developer to design, develop, and maintain integrations between Coupa BSM (Business Spend Management) and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on Coupa Integration Cloud, API-based integrations, supplier onboarding flows, and data synchronization between Coupa and ERP, finance, HR, and payment systems. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Coupa integrations in production, understands the source-to-pay process end-to-end, and applies disciplined integration engineering practices. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integrations between Coupa and enterprise systems including ERP, finance, payroll, and supplier networks.
  • Build integrations using Coupa Integration Cloud, Coupa Open APIs, and middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Workato.
  • Implement supplier onboarding integrations including supplier master, contracts, and catalog data flows.
  • Develop integrations supporting requisition, purchase order, invoice, and payment processes.
  • Implement chart-of-accounts, expense category, and lookup data synchronization between Coupa and source systems.
  • Build user, role, and approval-hierarchy synchronization between Coupa and identity systems.
  • Design error handling, retry, and reconciliation strategies for integration flows.
  • Implement integration security across Coupa endpoints, including OAuth flows, SSO patterns, and certificate-based authentication, ensuring that integration credentials follow least-privilege and lifecycle best practices.
  • Profile and optimize integration performance and batch sizing for high-volume scenarios, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Participate in Coupa release planning, regression testing, and platform upgrades.
  • Collaborate with procurement, finance, and IT stakeholders on integration requirements.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Support production incidents related to Coupa integrations and drive durable fixes.
  • Stay current with Coupa releases and BSM platform evolution, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of integration engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience integrating Coupa with enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of Coupa Integration Cloud and Coupa Open APIs.
  • Experience with at least one major iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Workato.
  • Strong understanding of source-to-pay and procure-to-pay processes.
  • Solid SQL and data transformation skills.
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, and integration security.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Coupa certifications.
  • Experience integrating Coupa with SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite ERP systems.
  • Familiarity with Coupa Pay, Coupa Risk Assess, or Coupa Treasury.
  • Exposure to supplier-network integrations.
  • Experience supporting global BSM rollouts.

raw.description:
About us

As one of Germany's leading HealthTech companies, we are transforming discharge management by making it technology driven, patient centered, and free of bureaucracy. In addition to our market leading SaaS platform, we are developing AI solutions that radically simplify processes in clinics and for aftercare providers, relieve the burden on healthcare professionals, and put the focus back on patients. We currently connect over two thirds of all German hospitals with more than 650 rehabilitation clinics, and over 25,000 care and homecare providers. With around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we are continuing to grow and are looking for people with the right attitude who want to improve the healthcare system alongside us.

We're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What you'll work on

Aftercare provider operations are becoming increasingly complex and data driven. Bringing change is very hard, but we're not afraid. You'll build features that help care facilities, rehabilitation centers, and healthcare chains better allocate resources, unlock actionable insights from patient data, and integrate Recare seamlessly into their internal systems.

Our ambitious roadmap focuses on expanding our marketplace's receiver side with enhanced analytics tools, B2C platforms connecting providers directly with patients, expanded API integrations, and much more.

Secure communication is at our core. Our solution provides end to end encryption for healthcare professionals to safely exchange messages and patient data through both our applications and external API integrations.

In this role, you will:

  • Own a domain inside our core Go codebase, contributing to architecture decisions and code quality within your area

  • Work inside a well structured system with some standalone services around the edges, including an on premise gateway for hospital integrations, rather than a sprawling microservices estate

  • Step in and keep things moving when your lead is away, taking ownership with confidence rather than waiting for instruction

  • Contribute to pull requests, reviews, and technical discussions as a trusted senior voice on your team

We have several products in development that we are confident will significantly impact the German healthcare system. And yes, we're excited by the new opportunities AI unlocks for building powerful features for our customers and our own workflow.

What technologies you'll work with

  • Golang. Our entire backend codebase is in Golang, and we love it. It's easy to learn, it's strongly typed, the internal tooling is fantastic, and it compiles fast.

  • Postgres. We use Postgres for our databases and GORM to interface with it.

  • CI and DevOps. We use both CircleCI and GitHub Actions to run our unit and integration tests, visual regression tests built in house, and automated code analysis through SonarCloud. They're also used to deploy to our various environments.

We also dedicate some of our time to work on non business tasks, which means for instance:

  • Continuously optimising the backend code to offer the best user experience

  • Analysing and improving database slowdowns and issues

  • Internal automation, because we want to make our lives easier

  • Building additional tooling, such as performance profiling tools to identify bottlenecks in backend services and optimise resource usage

Our philosophy is that developers are owners of the code they write until it gets to production. We rely a lot on automated tests to ensure everything stays stable. The rule is that code could be deployed at any time, and manual QA is only involved in new feature validation.

This is what you can expect from us

  • Work with Purpose. Your work has a real impact on patients and healthcare professionals in the medical field.

  • Corporate Culture. We embrace structures that foster high performance and strong team dynamics. Our interactions are characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. We work together towards common goals and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility. Would you like to pick up your child from daycare? Do you enjoy exercising during lunchtime? We support you in achieving that balance. Besides flexible working hours, as a remote-first company we offer the flexibility to work 100% remotely from Germany, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland, France and Austria.

  • Edenred card, which you can use in the way that suits you best.

  • Extra Day Off on Your Birthday, so you can celebrate with your loved ones.

Your responsibilities as a Senior Backend Engineer will include

  • Technical Ownership. Own a domain inside our Go codebase, contribute to architectural decisions and code quality within your area, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and suggest or implement improvements.

  • Stepping Up When Needed. Be ready to take charge of priorities and keep things moving if your lead is away, supporting and mentoring other engineers along the way without needing to manage a team.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with product and design to translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate technical progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.

  • Delivery. Ship reliably against the team's roadmap, help break down features into deliverable tasks, and identify and remove blockers as they come up.

  • Building With AI. We are an AI company now, and that shows up in how we expect people to work, not just what we build. Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your day to day, whether that is accelerating how you write and review code, prototyping ideas faster, or finding smarter ways to work. We do not expect you to vibe code everything end to end, plenty of our best engineers still want to write the core of what they ship themselves and use AI to speed things up around the edges. What matters is real curiosity about where this is heading, not scepticism about whether any of this changes how software gets built.

Requirements

What you will need to succeed as a Senior Backend Engineer:

  • We are looking for experienced developers. You have a CS degree or equivalent knowledge, and you have been coding full time professionally for 4 to 5 plus years

  • We're looking for someone with production experience in Golang, or another C family language with a real, demonstrable ability to operate in Go without hand holding

  • You have some experience supporting or mentoring other engineers, and you are looking for a strong individual contributor role rather than a path into people management

  • You want to become a technical owner of part of our codebase. We need people who are looking for responsibility, just not a team to manage

  • You are a clear, confident communicator, comfortable being put on the spot in a conversation and able to think out loud rather than defaulting to async only communication when something needs a real time answer

  • Since Product and Engineering work in a fully remote setup, writing skills matter more and more, so written questions, requirements, and docs are genuinely valuable

  • You should be comfortable and excited to dive into more advanced topics, for example build pipelines, caching mechanisms, and database optimisation

  • Since we're a small team, we want to automate a lot. You should have experience with CI and testing frameworks

  • You are proactive and proficient across the entire product development flow, asking questions, clarifying specs, raising doubts, and engaging in meetings

  • Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement. FHIR, HL7, or DICOM exposure is great to have, but we have hired strong engineers from fintech, insurtech, and other compliance heavy domains with zero healthcare background who did just fine

  • You are genuinely excited about what AI can do for engineering. We don't expect every line of code to be AI generated, but we do expect curiosity and a real point of view on where this is heading

raw.description:
Role: Jr. Product Manager, PreK-12
Team: Product
Reports to: VP, Product
Location: Flexible (Fully-Remote or Hybrid | Offices in NYC and Miami)

WHO WE ARE

The ASU+GSV Summit
Now in its 18th year, the ASU+GSV Summit is the world’s most important gathering of “PreK to Gray” education and workforce leaders. Held every April in San Diego, the 2026 event drew over 7,000 registrants to tackle the transformation of learning and skills delivery through generative AI, virtual reality, and other emerging technologies.

Frequently referred to as the “Davos of Education,” the ASU+GSV Summit brings together over 850 speakers each year, engaging in over 300 conversations around the future of learning and skills at scale. Past keynote speakers have included former President George W. Bush, Secretary Condoleezza Rice, Prime Minister Tony Blair, Sal Khan, Priscilla Chan, Ruby Bridges, Gloria Steinem, Jane Fonda, and countless others who have inspired our community to take bold action. Leading partners such as Google, Microsoft, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Gates Foundation, Walton Family Foundation, ClassDojo, and others help power this community. Through ongoing engagement and a global stage at ASU+GSV, you’ll help bring together the boldest thinkers reimagining what’s possible for the future of PreK-12 education.

As of July 2025, GSV Summit became part of Hyve Group's portfolio, joining forces with Bett to create the largest and most impactful education innovation community in the world, now reaching an audience of over 100,000 participants across five events on four continents.

WHO IS THE PRODUCT TEAM?

The Product Team is the creative and strategic engine behind the ASU+GSV Summit experience. We design and deliver the program of ASU+GSV, through curated content and experiences that inspire action: from high-production keynotes with global thought leaders to provocative panels, interactive workshops, community activations, and live product demos.

We bridge marketing, strategic partnerships, and community engagement to craft seamless, high-impact experiences for our attendees and partners. We collaborate closely with education leaders, practitioners, entrepreneurs, investors, policymakers, researchers, and thought leaders to shape the conversations that matter most in “PreK to Gray” learning.

Our work is structured around three core verticals—PreK-12, Higher Education, and Workforce—but the real power is in what we call “the magic in the mix.” Program often develops across verticals, so every team member takes a collaborative approach. We lean in to build the right program for the right audience at the right time, staying agile to launch new programs and rethink existing ones as needed.
ROLE OVERVIEW
We’re looking for a highly organized, execution-focused Jr. Product Manager to support the PreK-12 team at the ASU+GSV Summit. Reporting to the VP, Product and working closely with the Director, K12 Product, this role is about turning strategy into flawless execution. You will support in managing the details, logistics, and follow-through that bring the PreK-12 program to life.

Each year, 1,100+ PreK-12 leaders from 530+ districts and schools join us to explore the most pressing opportunities and challenges in PreK-12 education—from classroom innovation and educator support to school leadership, digital learning, and student outcomes.

You’ll partner closely with the Director, K12 Product to execute the PreK-12 content program, and collaborate with the SVP of Community, the VP of Educator Engagement, and the broader K12 community team to bring programming to life for our growing network of PreK-12 leaders. The role blends project management, program logistics, and cross-team coordination—requiring thoughtful collaboration, extreme precision, consistent follow-through, and a genuine curiosity about the PreK-12 landscape, including how AI is beginning to reshape it. That deep curiosity and eagerness to build understanding and discernment is what supports our team’s purpose: elevating the most cutting edge research, founders, and ideas, identifying the stars of tomorrow, and curating provocative conversations that push forward the most pressing challenges impacting the future of learning.


WHAT YOU WILL DO
As the Jr. Product Manager, PreK-12 you will be responsible for:

Program Execution & Project Management
  • Support the development and execution of the PreK-12 program under the direction of the Director, K12 Product—from researching emerging topics and identifying compelling voices to developing session concepts and bringing them to life at ASU+GSV Summit: ensuring that they are timely, relevant, and high-impact.
    • Across the product team, we work with 850+ speakers and 200+ partners to curate more 300 sessions each year, in addition to numerous bespoke community activations and experiences.
  • Supporting end-to-end program logistics: from speaker outreach and confirmation to session scheduling, run-of-show details, and final delivery.
  • Track and maintain accurate program documentation, session details, and speaker logistics with exceptional organization. No detail is too small.
  • Maintain the PreK-12 program calendar and pipeline, in coordination with partnership and community team to ensure a holistic approach, proactively flagging risks and dependencies

Partnership Support
  • Support the Director, K12 Product and the partnerships team in coordinating partner deliverables and activations tied to PreK-12 programming.
  • Track partner commitments and help ensure timely execution of partner-related program elements.
  • Help prepare materials and briefs for partner program involvement.
Community Collaboration
  • Partner closely with the SVP of Community, the VP of Educator Engagement, and the broader K12 community team to execute community engagement initiatives that support PreK-12 programming, in-person and year-round.
  • Help coordinate educator engagement touchpoints—webinars, community activations, and outreach—that feed the PreK-12 content pipeline.
  • Capture and organize community insights to help the Director, K12 Product surface emerging leaders, trends, and conversation topics.
Relationship Management & Stakeholder Communication
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for PreK-12 speakers, moderators, and partners—managing logistics, scheduling, and communications with professionalism and responsiveness.
  • Support the Director, K12 Product in engaging PreK-12 superintendents, principals, educators, EdTech founders, and policymakers to inform program development and ensure content reflects the opportunities, challenges, and perspectives shaping the field.
Technology & Process Excellence
  • Use Airtable, Cvent, generative AI, and other tools to streamline workflows and enhance program delivery.
  • Identify and test new technologies that can improve efficiency, attendee experience, and business outcomes.

WHO YOU ARE
Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 1–2 years of previous experience in program/product management or a similar role that requires excellent attention to detail and ability to translate from strategy to execution
  • PreK-12 education or EdTech experience a strong plus
Skills & Qualities
  • Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented: You track dozens of moving pieces without dropping a thread, and you build the systems to keep everything on track. No detail is too small.
  • Execution-Focused: You’re energized by getting things done—turning plans into action and keeping programs moving forward through prompt, reliable follow-through.
  • Collaborative & Coachable: You understand that great program execution depends on keeping multiple teams aligned and are an effective team-player working across teams on shared projects and initiatives. You take direction and feedback well, and are eager to learn the PreK-12 landscape.
  • Community Builder: You think about programming through the eyes of the people in the room and are curious about what will make a conversation useful, surprising, and relevant to different PreK–12 audiences
  • Strong Communicator: You write and speak clearly and professionally—whether confirming a speaker, updating a partner, or briefing your manager.
  • Calm Under Pressure: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and stay composed as details shift in the weeks leading up to Summit.
  • Curious About Education & AI: You’re genuinely interested in how AI and technology are reshaping PreK-12 education, and eager to grow your expertise in the sector.
  • Proactive Problem-Solver: You anticipate issues before they become problems and bring solutions, not just questions, to your manager.
  • Tech-Forward & Tech-Savvy: You’re facile with tools like Airtable, Cvent, Google Workspace, and AI-powered platforms that boost efficiency and enhance program delivery.

This role requires a willingness to travel and work extended hours in the weeks leading up to the Summit, as well as supplemental travel throughout the year.

GSV is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.excerpt: WHO WE AREAt Jampp, we’re on the mission of playing a leading role enabling the mobile app economy to grow.
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Jampp, we’re on the mission of playing a leading role enabling the mobile app economy to grow. How? We build technology to support the most ambitious companies - from gaming to commerce pioneers - to propel the reach of their apps and accelerate their mobile businesses.

A demand-side platform (DSP) at heart, the technical challenges we face every day are huge: from processing over 2 million auctions per second in less than 40ms each, to efficiently storing over 150TB of events’ data daily, to continuously choosing the optimal price level for 300+ campaigns spending several million dollars every month in a constantly changing market, there’s never a boring day at Jampp!

WHY DO WE NEED YOU?

At Jampp, we solve the most complex and large-scale technological challenges in mobile advertising today. We process over 2,500,000 ad requests per second, which amounts to over 250TB of data per day, across three global data centers. We rely on real-time machine learning models (with billions of features) that give us predictions in less than 100ms. If you've spent your career building real-time, high-throughput data pipelines and want to own the architecture behind systems handling a billion events daily, Jampp is the right place for you.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you won't just build pipelines. You'll set the technical direction for how Jampp's data infrastructure evolves. You'll design, architect, and operate large-scale distributed systems across all environments, make key technology decisions, and mentor the engineers around you as we build our next-generation data infrastructure.

If you have deep, hands-on experience with distributed systems at scale, a strong command of Python, and you thrive owning ambiguous, high-impact technical problems in a fast-paced environment, you might be the new Jampper we're looking for.

WHAT YOU´LL DO

  • Own the architecture and technical roadmap for key pieces of Jampp's data infrastructure, not just implement it, but define how it should evolve.
  • Design and implement ETL processes from a wide variety of sources, with an eye toward scalability, incrementality, and long-term maintainability.
  • Partner closely with Data Scientists and other Senior/Staff engineers to design scalable data models and pipelines that support real-time ML infrastructure.
  • Drive data consistency and reliability standards across Jampp's systems and machine learning inputs, including defining what "good" looks like for the rest of the team.
  • Identify and resolve systemic bottlenecks: benchmark systems, diagnose root causes, and propose architectural solutions rather than one-off fixes.
  • Build and evolve the tools and frameworks that empower colleagues across the company to access data and build reliable, scalable transformations on their own.
  • Mentor and coach mid-level and junior engineers. You'll be a technical reference point on the team, not just an individual contributor.
  • Contribute to technical decision-making around tooling and infrastructure choices, weighing trade-offs at a systems level.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years of programming experience in Python, with a track record of building and owning production-grade distributed systems. Go is a plus.
  • Proven experience architecting and scaling distributed data processing systems, not just maintaining pipelines someone else designed, but making the core design decisions yourself.
  • Deep hands-on experience with the AWS Big Data stack (Kinesis, EMR, Lambda, etc.) in high-throughput, transaction- or event-scale environments, think fintech, payments, e-commerce, ad-tech, or gaming, where real-time or near-real-time data volume is core to the business.
  • Strong experience managing and operating TrinoDB/PrestoDB clusters in production.
  • Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and PySpark, comfortable owning the infrastructure these run on, not just deploying to it.
  • Rock-solid knowledge of databases and SQL, including performance tuning at scale.
  • Databricks experience is a strong plus.
  • A track record of mentoring and coaching engineers. This role expects you to actively raise the technical bar of the team.
  • Engagement with the open source community (raising issues, contributing PRs, participating in technical discussions) is a strong extra, it signals the kind of depth we're looking for.
  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership and ambiguity, and making sound architectural calls without needing everything spelled out.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • 📱 Learn a ton about the hottest area of growth in Internet advertising - Mobile!
  • 💰 Competitive salary, benchmarked to attract senior talent from high-growth tech, fintech, and e-commerce companies.
  • 📈 High technical ownership from day one, with real influence over architecture decisions and the team's technical direction.
  • 💪🏼 An entrepreneurial environment.
  • A dynamic remote-first work culture with the possibility of accessing coworking spaces as needed.
  • 🤓 A structured remote onboarding process and continuous training with a supportive team. We win together!
  • Work with a talented global team you can constantly learn from. We have Jamppers from 🇧🇷🇬🇧🇺🇸🇮🇪🇫🇷🇩🇪🇦🇷🇷🇺... our customers are not the only ones from around the globe 😉
  • 😎 Cool swag and team activities (even when working from home!)
